scripts.prod-each: lerna run prod && npm run test-build
scripts.demo: yarn run examples && cd ./demo/ && yarn run build && yarn run docker
scripts.examples: npm run build-dts && npm run examples:check
scripts.publish:packages: npm run test-build && lerna publish from-package
scripts.patch: npm run test-build && lerna version patch --exact --conventional-commits -m "chore(release): publish %s" --no-push --create-release github
scripts.minor: npm run test-build && lerna version minor --exact --conventional-commits -m "chore(release): publish %s" --no-push --create-release github
scripts.major: npm run test-build && lerna version major --exact --conventional-commits -m "chore(release): publish %s" --no-push --create-release github
scripts.prerelease: npm run test-build && lerna version --exact --conventional-commits --conventional-prerelease -m "chore(release): publish %s" --no-push --create-release github
scripts.premajor: npm run test-build && lerna version premajor --exact --conventional-commits -m "chore(release): publish %s" --preid alpha --no-push --create-release github
